modes.name: katn
modes.label: Race - Kefka @ Narshe
modes.help: Play the normal story up to Kefka at Narshe. Intended for racing.

modes.name: ancientcave
modes.label: Ancient Cave
modes.help: Play through a long randomized dungeon.

modes.name: speedcave
modes.label: Speed Cave
modes.help: Play through a medium-sized randomized dungeon.

modes.name: racecave
modes.label: Race - Randomized Cave
modes.help: Play through a short randomized dungeon.

modes.name: dragonhunt
modes.label: Race - Dragon Hunt
modes.help: Kill all 8 dragons in the World of Ruin. Intended for racing.

b.label: Fix exploits
b.help: Make the game more balanced by removing known bugs and exploits.

c.label: Random palettes and names
c.help: Randomize palettes and names of various things.

e.label: Random espers
e.help: Randomize esper spells and levelup bonuses.

h.label: Random final party
h.help: Your party in the Final Kefka fight will be random.

i.label: Random equipment
i.help: Randomize the stats of equippable items.

p.label: Random animation palettes
p.help: The Pixel Remaster's spell and weapon effects are its own particle art, not palette sprites.  Randomize the palettes of spells and weapon animations.

q.label: Random character stats and equipment
q.help: Randomize what equipment each character can wear and character stats.

r.label: Shuffle World of Ruin recruits
r.help: Randomize character locations in the world of ruin.

t.label: Random treasure, shops and drops
t.help: Randomize treasure including chests, colosseum, shops, and enemy drops.

u.label: Umaro's berserk for someone
u.help: Umaro risk. (Random character will be berserk)

w.label: Replace commands
w.help: Generate new commands for characters,replacing old commands.

bravenudeworld.label: Everyone looks like Esper Terra
bravenudeworld.help: All characters use the Esper Terra sprite.

kupokupo.label: Moogle party
kupokupo.help: All party members are moogles except Mog. With partyparty, all characters are moogles, except Mog, Esper Terra, and Imps.

makeover.label: New character sprites
makeover.help: Some sprites are replaced with new ones (like Cecil or Zero Suit Samus).

novanilla.label: No original sprites
novanilla.help: Use with 'makeover' to have sprites from the vanilla game to be guaranteed not to appear.

frenchvanilla.label: Original sprites as likely as new
frenchvanilla.help: Use with 'makeover' to have sprites from the vanilla game be selected with equal weight to new sprites.

cloneparty.label: Clone party
cloneparty.help: Use with 'makeover' to have the randomizer actively try to choose spriteversions of the same character.

partyparty.label: Guest sprites in the mix
partyparty.help: Kefka, Trooper, Banon, Leo, Ghost, Merchant, Esper Terra, and Soldier are included in the pool of sprite randomization

quikdraw.label: Imperial soldier party
quikdraw.help: All characters look like imperial soldiers, and none of them have Gau's Rage skill.

informativemiss.label: Informative misses
informativemiss.help: Effects will display 'Miss', 'Null', or 'Fail' depending on why the effect failed to land.

magicnumbers.label: Coloured MP numbers
magicnumbers.help: Changes MP damage and MP healing to display in a different color than HP damage and HP healing.

mpparty.label: Party change refills MP
mpparty.help: MP is also refilled when you form a party, instead of just HP.

nicerpoison.label: Less poison pixelation
nicerpoison.help: An SNES display fix: the Pixel Remaster draws Poison its own way.  Drastically reduces the pixelation effect of poison when in dungeons.

questionablecontent.label: Mark changed items with ?
questionablecontent.help: Equipment Beyond Chaos changed gets a ? after its name, and its description says what changed (the spell it casts, elements, stats).

regionofdoom.label: Doom Gaze finder
regionofdoom.help: Enables a dialog on the World of Ruin Airship to automatically find and fight Doom Gaze.

relicmyhat.label: Combined equipment menus
relicmyhat.help: The Pixel Remaster's equipment and shop screens already work this way.  Combines the equipment and relic menus, and makes shop menus more informative.

removeflashing.label: Remove flashing
removeflashing.help: Edits SNES animation scripts; the Pixel Remaster's effects are its own.  "All" removes most white flashing effects from the game. "BumRush" just removes the Bum Rush flashing.

slowerbg.label: Slower scrolling backgrounds
slowerbg.help: An SNES display fix: the Pixel Remaster scrolls its backgrounds its own way.  Drastically reduces the speed of vertical scrolling backgrounds.

tastetherainbow.label: Cycling status auras
tastetherainbow.help: SNES status-aura palette cycling; the Pixel Remaster draws status effects its own way.  Enables cycling of status effect auras on characters in-battle.

alasdraco.label: Random opera
alasdraco.help: Randomizes various aesthetic elements of the Opera.

bingoboingo.label: Bingo cards
bingoboingo.help: Generates a Bingo table with various game elements to witness and check off. The ROM does not interact with the bingo board.

capslockoff.label: Mixed-case names
capslockoff.help: Names use whatever capitalization is in the name lists instead of all caps.

johnnyachaotic.label: Chaotic music
johnnyachaotic.help: Randomizes music with no regard to what would make sense in a given location.

johnnydmad.label: New music
johnnydmad.help: Randomizes music with regard to what would make sense in a given location.

notawaiter.label: Cutscene skips
notawaiter.help: Up to Kefka at Narshe, the vast majority of mandatory cutscenes are completely removed. Optional cutscenes are not removed.

remonsterate.label: New monster sprites
remonsterate.help: Replaces monster sprites with sprites from other games. Requires sprites in the remonstrate\sprites folder. May introduce sketch glitching.

collateraldamage.label: Item break mode
collateraldamage.help: All equipment break for spells. Characters only have Fight and Item commands. Enemies will use items drastically more often than usual.

cursepower.label: Cursed Shield battles
cursepower.help: Set the number of battles required to uncurse a Cursed Shield. (Vanilla = 255, 0 = Random)

dancelessons.label: No dance failures
dancelessons.help: Removes the 50% chance that dances will fail when used on a different terrain.

dancingmaduin.label: Restricted espers
dancingmaduin.help:
Espers can only be equipped by specific characters. Choose the minimum amount of characters per Esper. Usually changes Paladin Shld spell. 
Random chooses the same random minimum for all Espers; Chaos chooses them separately.

darkworld.label: Slasher's delight (hard mode)
darkworld.help: Drastically increases the difficulty of the seed, akin to a hard mode. Mostly meant to be used in conjunction with the madworld flag.

electricboogaloo.label: Wild item breaks
electricboogaloo.help: Increases the list of spells that items can break and proc for from just magic and some summons to include almost any skill.

expboost.label: EXP multiplier
expboost.help: All battles will award multiplied exp.

gpboost.label: Gil multiplier
gpboost.help: All battles will award multiplied gp.

lessfanatical.label: Easy Fanatics' Tower
lessfanatical.help: Disables forced magic command in Fanatic's Tower.

madworld.label: Tierless (tiers for fears)
madworld.help: Creates a "true tierless" seed, with enemies having a higher degree of randomization and shops being very randomized as well.

masseffect.label: Wild equipment effects
masseffect.help: Increases the number of rogue effects on equipment

mpboost.label: AP multiplier
mpboost.help: All battles will award multiplied magic points.

nobreaks.label: No item breaks
nobreaks.help: Causes no items to break for spell effects.

norng.label: No randomness in battle
norng.help: Almost all calls to the RNG are removed, and actions are much less random as a result.

playsitself.label: Autobattle
playsitself.help: All characters will act automatically, in a manner similar to when Coliseum fights are fought.

randombosses.label: Random boss skills
randombosses.help: Causes boss skills to be randomized similarly to regular enemy skills. Boss skills can change to similarly powerful skills.

rushforpower.label: Old Vargas fight
rushforpower.help: Reverts the Vargas fight to only require that Vargas take any damage to begin his second phase.

swdtechspeed.label: Bushido gauge speed
swdtechspeed.help: Alters the speed at which the SwdTech bar moves.

unbreakable.label: Unbreakable items
unbreakable.help: Causes all items to be indestructible when broken for a spell.

bsiab.label: Unbalanced monster boxes
bsiab.help: Greatly increases the variance of monster-in-a-box encounters and removes some sanity checks, allowing them to be much more difficult and volatile

cursedencounters.label: Expanded encounters
cursedencounters.help: Increases all zones to have 16 possible enemy encounters.

dearestmolulu.label: No random encounters
dearestmolulu.help: No random encounters occur. Items that alter encounter rates increase them. EXP flag recommended

fightclub.label: Hidden Colosseum rewards
fightclub.help: Does not allow you to see the coliseum rewards before betting, but you can often run from the coliseum battles to keep your item.

mimetime.label: Hidden Gogo
mimetime.help: Gogo will be hidden somewhere in the World of Ruin disguised as another character. Bring that character to him to recruit him.

morefanatical.label: Harder Fanatics' Tower
morefanatical.help: Later in this port (with the random final dungeon).  Fanatic's Tower is even more confusing than usual.

nomiabs.label: No monster boxes
nomiabs.help: Chests will never have monster encounters in them.

randomboost.label: Randomness boost
randomboost.help: Increases the strength of randomization for chests, steals, drops, skills, and Esper spells. (0=uniform distribution)

thescenarionottaken.label: Divergent paths
thescenarionottaken.help: Later in this port (Divergent paths).  Changes the way the 3 scenarios are split up, to resemble PowerPanda's 'Divergent Paths' mod.

worringtriad.label: Start in the World of Ruin
worringtriad.help: The player will start in the World of Ruin, with all of the World of Balance treasure chests, along with a guaranteed set of items, and more Lores.

allcombos.label: All combo skills
allcombos.help: All skills that get replaced with something are replaced with combo skills.

canttouchthis.label: Invincible party
canttouchthis.help: All characters have 255 Defense and 255 Magic Defense, as well as 128 Evasion and Magic Evasion.

desperation.label: Desperation attacks
desperation.help: Guarantees one character will have R-Limit, and greatly increases the chance of having desperation attacks as commands.

endless9.label: Endless nine (9x skills)
endless9.help: All R-[skills] are automatically changed to 9x[skills]. W-[skills] will become 8x[skills].

levelcap.label: Level cap
levelcap.help: Set a maximum level for your characters. Toggle on to reveal additional options.

cap_type.label: Cap type
cap_type.help: How should the level cap behave? Random: Roll one level cap, apply it to all characters. Chaos: Roll a different level cap for each character.

cap_min.label: Lowest cap
cap_min.help: The minimum value that characters can roll as their capped level.

cap_max.label: Highest cap
cap_max.help: The maximum value that characters can roll as their capped level.

mementomori.label: Innate relics
mementomori.help: Number of characters that begin with an innate relic ability.

metronome.label: Random Chaos for everyone
metronome.help: All characters have Fight, R-Chaos, Magic, and Item as their skillset, except for the Mime, who has Mimic instead of Fight, and the Berserker, who only has R-Chaos.

naturalmagic.label: Natural magic only
naturalmagic.help: No Espers or equipment will teach spells. The only way for characters to learn spells is through leveling up, if they have their own innate magic list.

naturalstats.label: No esper stat bonuses
naturalstats.help: No Espers will grant stat bonuses upon leveling up.

nocombos.label: No combo skills
nocombos.help: There will be no combo(dual) skills.

penultima.label: No Ultima
penultima.help: Ultima cannot be learned by any means.

replaceeverything.label: Replace every skill
replaceeverything.help: All vanilla skills that can be replaced, are replaced.

shadowstays.label: Shadow stays
shadowstays.help: Shadow no longer has a chance to leave the party in random battles

supernatural.label: Natural magic for every caster
supernatural.help: Makes it so that any character with the Magic command will have natural magic.

suplexwrecks.label: Suplex mode (everyone is Sabin)
suplexwrecks.help: All characters use the Sabin sprite, have a name similar to Sabin, have the Blitz and Suplex commands, and can hit every enemy with Suplex.

airship.label: Airship from the start
airship.help: The player can access the airship after leaving Narshe, or from any chocobo stable. Doing events out of order can cause softlocks.

equipanything.label: Equip anything
equipanything.help: Armor and relics can be held in a hand, as a shield is; items that aren't equipment can't (the game's equip lists hold only weapons and armor).  Items that are not equippable normally can now be equipped as weapons or shields. These often give strange defensive stats or weapon animations.

sketch.label: Sketch glitch
sketch.help: The Sketch glitch is SNES memory corruption the Pixel Remaster doesn't have.  Enables sketch bug. Not recommended unless you know what you are doing.

strangejourney.label: Bizarre adventure (entrances)
strangejourney.help: A prototype entrance randomizer, similar to the ancientcave mode. Includes all maps and event tiles, and is usually extremely hard to beat by itself.

espercutegf.label: Summoner mode
espercutegf.help: Characters gain the traits of equipped espers. Casters can change equipped esper mid-battle.

espffect.label: Junction effects on espers
espffect.help: Attach random effects from the "Junction" patch set to espers.

effectmas.label: Junction effects on equipment
effectmas.help: Attach random effects from the "Junction" patch set to equipment (excluding relics). Low potential for softlocks.

effectory.label: Junction effects on relics
effectory.help: Attach random effects from the "Junction" patch set to relics. Low potential for softlocks.

effectster.label: Junction effects on monsters
effectster.help: Attach random effects from the "Junction" patch set to monsters, rages, and some statuses. Medium potential for softlocks.

treaffect.label: Monsters' item junction effects
treaffect.help: Monsters inherit the "Junction" effects of held items. Medium potential for softlocks.

jejentojori.label: Innate relic junctions
jejentojori.help: Innate "mementomori" relics retain their junction effects. High potential for softlocks.

object.label: Object sprites
object.help: Adjust probability of selecting object sprites.

kids.label: Kid sprites
kids.help: Adjust probability of selecting kids sprites.

girls.label: Girl sprites
girls.help: Adjust probability of selecting girls sprites.

anime.label: Anime sprites
anime.help: Adjust probability of selecting anime sprites.

boys.label: Boy sprites
boys.help: Adjust probability of selecting boys sprites.

generic.label: Generic sprites
generic.help: Adjust probability of selecting generic sprites.

animals.label: Animal sprites
animals.help: Adjust probability of selecting animals sprites.
